nodes.title: IMPORTANT

widgets_values:
NINE-LAYER SURREAL SHOWCASE — Night market under the neon moon
A retro-futurist night market on an alien world, where every region keeps its own style: photoreal stalls, an oil-painted traveler, watercolor twilight, charcoal smoke, vector neon, chrome hotdog ornaments.
nodes.title: CONDITIONING LAYERS — EXAMPLE 09

widgets_values: Nine independently controlled conditioning layers combine geometry, gradients, procedural fields, patterns and painting in one scene.
nodes.title: WHAT THIS SHOWS

widgets_values: Disable layers one at a time, change their prompts, or open the Painted Fields together to see which part of the scene each layer owns.
nodes.title: TRY THIS

widgets_values: This workflow is intentionally large. Start with Examples 01–08 if you're learning the system.
nodes.title: IMPORTANT

widgets_values: A crowded retro-futurist night market on an alien world, lantern-lit food stalls and chrome kiosks along a wet stone street, photoreal cinematic film still.
nodes.title: L1 · Market street (prompt)

widgets_values: L1 lays the photoreal market street across the lower three quarters of the frame. L2 hangs a vector-neon moon in the sky above it.
nodes.title: WHAT THIS SHOWS

widgets_values: A colossal glowing magenta moon ringed with neon halos, flat vector neon poster style.
nodes.title: L2 · Neon moon (prompt)

widgets_values: The radial field is brightest at the moon's center and fades to nothing at its rim, so the vector-neon style melts into the watercolor sky instead of ending at a hard edge.
nodes.title: WHAT THIS SHOWS

widgets_values: A cloaked wandering traveler holding a brass lantern, rendered as a Renaissance oil painting with visible brushstrokes and warm chiaroscuro.
nodes.title: L3 · Oil-painted traveler (prompt)

widgets_values: L3 is FIXED: the oil-painted traveler owns every sample of the painted silhouette, so the photoreal market cannot blend into them. Keep other FIXED fields away from it.
nodes.title: IMPORTANT

widgets_values: Open this field, choose Add Field…, and add L7, L8 and L9: four fields in one session, one editable at a time, the others shown as overlays.
nodes.title: TRY THIS
Fade · warm pocket over the stalls

widgets_values: Cold teal alien twilight sky with drifting clouds, loose watercolor washes on textured paper.
nodes.title: L4 · Watercolor twilight (prompt)

widgets_values: Cold watercolor twilight fades down from the sky. The circular Fade dims it over the stalls, leaving a warm pocket of lantern light in the middle of the cold.
nodes.title: WHAT THIS SHOWS

widgets_values: Drifting smoke and steam from the food stalls, smudged charcoal drawing on rough paper.
nodes.title: L5 · Charcoal smoke (prompt)

widgets_values: Seeded Noise is thresholded by Remap into separate smoke banks, then a Fade keeps them low, so smoke rolls along the street instead of hiding the moon.
nodes.title: WHAT THIS SHOWS

widgets_values: Rows of glowing vector neon shop signs and tattered paper posters with alien lettering, bold flat graphic shapes.
nodes.title: L6 · Vector neon signs (prompt)

widgets_values: One library pattern becomes rows of signs: Repeat multiplies the cross, Invert turns the gaps between crosses into sign panels, Transform squeezes them onto the stall fronts.
nodes.title: WHAT THIS SHOWS

widgets_values: Swirling golden sparks and glowing embers rising into the night, tiny bright points of light with a dreamlike glow.
nodes.title: L7 · Sparkle embers (prompt)

widgets_values: Custom Tip embers: the same original sparkle tip as Example 07, stamped as a trail of sparks rising from the traveler's lantern into the sky.
nodes.title: WHAT THIS SHOWS

widgets_values: Floating polished chrome hotdog ornaments with bright glinting edges, drifting above the market like lanterns.
nodes.title: L8 · Chrome hotdogs (prompt)

widgets_values: The absurd detail: two clicks of Hotdog Count 3 (Spread 85%, Hotdog Size 80%, Hotdog Rotation 15°, Rotation Jitter 30) hang six chrome hotdog outlines above the stalls.
nodes.title: WHAT THIS SHOWS

widgets_values: Delicate hand-painted ivory highlights and rim light catching wet edges, fine brush detail.
nodes.title: L9 · Painted highlights (prompt)

widgets_values: Fine highlights along the rooftops, the wet street and the traveler's edge, painted as tapered pen strokes. Brush: Size 6, Amount 85, Hardness 40, Pen Pressure ▸ Size on; a mouse paints at full size.
nodes.title: WHAT THIS SHOWS

groups.title: L3 · Oil-painted traveler — Painted Field, FIXED
L4 · Watercolor twilight — Linear Gradient → Fade
L5 · Charcoal smoke — Noise → Remap → Fade
L6 · Vector neon signs — Pattern → Repeat → Invert → Transform
L7 · Sparkle embers — Painted Field, Custom Tip
L9 · Painted highlights — Painted Field, Pen Pressure
